title: feat(accounts): user accounts with synced favorite locations
head: feature/user-accounts
author: skylark-dev
body:
## Summary

Adds registration, login and token refresh to the API using HS256 JWTs, plus a favorites resource scoped to the signed-in user. The web app gets an auth context, a sign-in form, a favorites panel that polls for changes, and a save-to-favorites star on the current conditions card.

## Changes

- **API**: `/api/auth/{register,login,refresh,me,logout}`, `/api/favorites` CRUD, `requireAuth` middleware
- **Stores**: in-memory user and favorites stores (persistence to follow in a separate PR)
- **Web**: `AuthProvider` with token storage, `LoginForm`, `FavoritesPanel`, `useFavorites` polling hook
- **Core**: `User`, `AuthTokens`, `Favorite`, `FavoriteWithWeather` types

## Testing

- Added `auth.test.ts` covering register + login happy path
- Manually tested sign in, save favorite, remove favorite, sign out in Chrome

## Notes

The `JWT_SECRET` env var is new. Defaults to a dev value locally.
